variants.prompt: On a deserted Oslo beach at dawn, Freya stands in the shallow surf, the pre-sunrise light casting a warm, pinkish hue on her skin. She wears a tiny string bikini, the fabric barely covering her essentials, and a sheer, gauzy cover-up that clings to her shapely figure, hinting at the lingerie underneath. Her wet hair clings to her neck and shoulders, while her sultry, half-lidded eyes gaze directly at the viewer with an unmistakable "come hither" look. The camera captures her in a shallow depth of field, the background a soft blur of sand and sea, emphasizing her provocative, statuesque pose.
